title: Right to Be Forgotten Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request data deletion from online services. Exercise your right to erasure under GDPR with this professional letter format.
description: A professional letter template to help you exercise your right to be forgotten by requesting companies delete your personal data. Includes GDPR references and step-by-step guidance for submitting effective data deletion requests.

sections.content:

sections.heading: Subject Line
sections.content: Subject: Request for Data Deletion Under Right to Be Forgotten / Right to Erasure

sections.heading: Opening Statement
sections.content:
Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to formally request the deletion of all personal data you hold about me under my right to be forgotten (right to erasure) as provided by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 17, and applicable data protection laws.

sections.heading: Account Identification
sections.content:
Please find my account details below for identification purposes:

• Full Name: [Your Full Name]
• Email Address: [Your Email]
• Username/Account ID: [Username if applicable]
• Phone Number: [Your Phone Number]
• Any other relevant identifiers: [Other details]

sections.heading: Deletion Request Details
sections.content:
I hereby request that you:

1. Permanently delete all personal data you hold about me from your systems
2. Confirm that my data has been removed from all databases, backups, and archives
3. Notify any third parties with whom you have shared my data to delete it as well
4. Provide written confirmation of the complete data deletion

This request covers all personal information including but not limited to: account information, transaction history, communications, cookies, logs, and any derived or inferred data profiles.

sections.heading: Legal Basis
sections.content:
I believe my request meets the criteria for erasure under GDPR Article 17 because:

☐ The personal data is no longer necessary for the original purpose
☐ I withdraw my consent and there is no other legal basis for processing
☐ My personal data has been unlawfully processed
☐ Other reason: [Specify if applicable]

Please select the applicable reason(s) above.

sections.heading: Response Timeline
sections.content: Under GDPR, you have one month from receipt of this request to respond. Please acknowledge receipt of this request and provide a timeline for completion. If you cannot fulfill this request, please explain your legal basis for refusal in writing.

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your confirmation that my personal data has been permanently deleted from your systems.

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]
